entities.summary: Georg Weig, SVD was a German prelate of the Roman Catholic Church. He served as Prefect of the Apostolic Prefecture of Qingdao and Vicar Apostolic of the Apostolic Vicariate of Qingdao. Bishop Weig's Chinese name was Wei Changlu.
